# Mustangs, Etc. (concept by Kerblabs, not live for the business)

> Classic Mustang and vintage Ford parts, service, repair and restoration. Van Nuys, CA, owner-run since 1976.

- Parts: used, rebuilt, reproduction, NOS; FoMoCo, All Classic Parts and own reproduction line
- Services: service, repair, restoration
- Listed part prices: roughly $7 to $650
- Phone and street address: not published on the homepage
- Source: https://www.mustangsetc.com
- Instagram: @mustangsetc
